## 1. Prediction market

With 64 days to the first round, total accumulated volume in the presidential market is around **USD 117.52M** ([Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) via the AFOS proxy, captured August 1 at 1:49pm BRT). **Lula** rose 1.00pp and went to **65.50% (USD 7.82M)**, the maximum of the AFOS series for a second consecutive session. **Flávio Bolsonaro** rose 0.40pp, to **24.75% (USD 7.79M)**, and the gap **widened** to **+40.75pp**, also the maximum of the series holding both names, which begins on May 3. On both days the record came **with the opponent rising alongside**: there was no downward repricing of Flávio, there was demand for the front-runner.

**Renan Santos** is the series finding: he fell 0.55pp and went to **7.60% (USD 8.72M)**, his lowest value since May 14, in a fifth consecutive session of decline. On July 23 he stood at 12.00% and has since given ground in eight of nine rounds, 4.40pp. Before May 14 the series holds lower values, which is why the window is declared.

The rest of the pack shrank alongside, the difference from July 31, when the signals were crossed: **Caiado** fell to **1.35% (USD 5.24M)** and **Camilo Santana** gave back 0.90pp, going to his series minimum, **0.45%**; Jair, Alckmin, Zema and Tarcísio gave ground or stood still, all below 1%.

In the placing books, Flávio **rose 1.00pp** in [first-round second place](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-2nd-place), to **79.50% (USD 216,000)**, and Renan gave way there. In [third place](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-3rd-place), **Caiado collapsed 5.00pp**, to **22.50%**, undoing the previous day's gain. [Impeachment of an STF justice](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) was flat at **3.10% (USD 83,000)** and the PL rose in the [Senate](https://polymarket.com/event/next-brazil-senate-election-most-seats-won), to 72.50%. The guard failed the first round and approved the second: prices go in firm.

## 2. What the institutes recorded

**There was no new national poll.** The latest remains Vox Brasil of July 31 (n=2,100, field July 26 to 28, margin of 2.15pp, BR-01084/2026): Lula 40.5% x Flávio 31.2% in the first round and 47.5% x 41.1% in the runoff.

The poll of the day is a **state** one and does not enter the national set: **Datafolha** in Pernambuco has **Lula 57% x Flávio 22%**, and in the governor's race **Raquel Lyra 48% x João Campos 42%**, tied in the runoff ([g1](https://news.google.?oc=5), [Jornal do Commercio](https://news.google.?oc=5)).

With Renan at 7.60% in the market and 3.0% in the polling, the distance between the two **narrowed** from 5.15pp to **4.60pp**, from the price side. On July 29 this synthesis called that distance, then 0.90pp, convergence; it quadrupled and is now receding.

## 3. What the press covered

Saturday was about **conventions**, and the most visible one had Flávio on another candidate's platform. Republicanos made official in São Paulo the bid of **Tarcísio de Freitas for re-election as state governor**, but Tarcísio himself **avoided nationalizing his speech** ([O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/08/01/ao-lado-de-flavio-tarcisio-chega-a-convencao-do-republicanos-em-sao-paulo.ghtml), [Folha de S.Paulo](https://news.google.?oc=5)). This synthesis separates what the coverage merges: **Saturday's is a state convention**, and the Republicanos national convention, which decides the presidential alliance, is on **August 4** ([Estadão](https://news.google.?oc=5)). Flávio remains **without a running mate four days from the August 5 deadline**, and **Michelle Bolsonaro** did not confirm her Senate bid ([Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/poder/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2026/07/michelle-deve-confirmar-candidatura-ao-senado-em-evento-com-flavio-e-lancar-irmao-como-suplente.shtml)). In the government camp, the PT held conventions in Ceará and Bahia, and the national one that makes Lula official is on **August 2** ([g1](https://news.google.?oc=5)).

On the judicial axis, the fact is from July 31. **André Mendonça authorized a second inquiry** by the Federal Police into **Fábio Luís Lula da Silva**, known as Lulinha, over his dealings with **Dataprev**, a day after the first one, over the Health Ministry ([g1](https://g1.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/07/31/mendonca-autoriza-pf-a-investigar-suposto-trafico-de-influencia-de-lulinha-no-governo.ghtml), [Estadão](https://www.estadao.com.br/politica/blog-do-fausto-macedo/pf-pede-segundo-inquerito-para-apurar-trafico-de-influencia-de-lulinha-e-empresario-na-dataprev/)). These are two open inquiries, and an inquiry is not a conviction. In the Master case, **Novo filed** a petition against **Jaques Wagner** with the Ethics Council, on the same day as the Bahia convention that made his name official.

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Market × poll:** the price moved **2.00pp across two sessions with no national poll in between**. The tops of July 31 and August 1 have no polling to accompany them, and the synthesis asserts no cause because there is nothing to assert.

> **Market × market:** Renan's winner contract falls for a fifth session while the second-place book gave three directions in three days: 6.10%, 9.35% and now 8.55%. What survives is the winner reading, where the USD 8.72M of volume sits.

> **Price × convention:** it is the second time in eight days that a convention coincides with the favourite breaking a ceiling: on July 25 the PL's, which launched Flávio, and now the Republicanos one. In both the synthesis recorded the coincidence and refused the cause.

## In summary

1. **Two series tops in two days**, and in both the gap widened with the opponent rising alongside.
2. **The whole chasing pack shrank**, and Renan has accumulated 4.40pp of decline across nine rounds.
3. **The convergence of July 29 recedes**: the distance between price and poll fell to 4.60pp, from the price side.
